prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Preset customization fallback flow during adoption was helpful (+8.0%), though another fallback flow later showed no clear effect.
Interactive wait screen tips & status was helpful (+5.1%), but other wait screen updates (progress bars, alerts, status screens, timers) showed no clear effect.
Story screen sequence reordering before path selection was helpful (+2.9%), though sign-in reordering showed no clear effect.
Specific copy changes can significantly hurt performance (desktop pet callout card -13.9%, adoption certificate ownership copy -7.7%), while other copy and layout changes showed no clear effect.
Sign-in changes (hints, layout, step order) and visual redesigns during adoption or path selection showed no clear effect.
Predictions consistently overestimate positive impact, but underestimated the story screen sequence reorder (predicted -1.0%, measured +2.9%).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -7.7% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_flow: +5.7% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -3.8% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: -1.0% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +2.9% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: -4.0% over 2 test(s)
- finish, layout: +1.4% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -5.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_screen: +3.0% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.0% over 4 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +0.2% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, layout: -0.0% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -1.3% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.1%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 62.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 85.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, new_screen] Pre-Selection Companion Intro Screen: Adds a new introductory screen prior to path selection showcasing companion interaction styles. (why: choose_path has a high mean time of 514s; introducing pet interaction styles early helps users choose their path faster.)
1: [home, new_flow] Interactive Pet Waiting Playroom Flow: Transforms the waiting screen into an interactive mascot playroom experience while generation completes in the background. (why: The home wait step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s; interactive engagement reduces drop-off during generation.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Retrieval Hint: Adds a reassuring hint text on the sign-in screen informing returning users that signing in restores their pets. (why: 8 support tickets reported pets missing or reset after signing in again; clear messaging prevents sign-in confusion.)
3: [home, wait_info] Background Rendering Notification Toggle: Enables a background notification trigger on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app while waiting. (why: Median wait time is 201s (mean 2336s); notifying users when generation completes prevents focus loss and abandonment.)
4: [adoption, copy] Adoption Celebration Certificate Copy: Refreshes adoption certificate screen copy with celebratory messaging about welcoming a new companion. (why: Adoption step drops to 62.7% conversion; inspiring copy encourages users to complete the adoption step.)
5: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Welcome Summary Screen: Adds a final desktop onboarding screen summarizing pet controls and desktop placement tips before finishing. (why: Support received 7 total emails regarding post-onboarding feature confusion and desktop pet controls.)

scores.note: Path selection has high mean time, but adding pre-screens carries risk of added friction.
Interactive wait experiences consistently show strong positive impact during long generation waits.
Supported directly by 8 support tickets and high drop-off, though sign-in hints historically yield minor lift.
Addresses high median wait times; wait info features show small positive historical returns (+2.0%).
Adoption stage loses many users, but prior adoption certificate copy test severely hurt performance (-7.7%).
